Stage computes renderKey = step.groupKey ?? step.id and keys its motion wrapper with it. ActiveScene renders the supplied Scene with the changing payload inside LayoutGroup.
Scene passes ENTITIES constants directly to nodes or through StepCard to Box. Box and SymbolChip forward layoutId through IconNode; Arrow, Label, Emphasis, and Frame pass it to their motion elements.

demo-integration.rationale: The delivered title contract is consumed, and presentation content remains separate from shared navigation, geometry, and motion behavior. The inspected shared constants have operational consumers.
evidence: Talk supplies the required title; Presentation forwards it to Header, whose browse branch renders {title}. PresentationProps declares that input as required.
Presentation consumes steps for the active scene and era navigation, and usePresentationNav initializes mode from initialMode.

demo-integration.rationale: Shared chrome exposes semantic current-state attributes and stable hooks consumed by presentation-local CSS. Attribution implementation and defaults are project-local.
evidence: Footer computes active progress from index === stepIndex and emits aria-current='step' with data-active. Toc computes the active era interval and emits aria-current='true' with data-a…
The demo stylesheet targets progress and TOC hooks with [data-active='true'] and supplies attribution styling.
Footer locally defines AND_SCENE_REPO_URL and renders the 'made by and-scene' anchor. Presentation mounts this local Footer.

demo-integration.rationale: The inspected architecture confines demo content, entity identities, scene composition, and styling to its presentation directory. The registry supplies discovery, while shared Presentation handles generic orchestration.
evidence: The presentations registry contains metadata and a lazy Talk import. Talk only imports local STEPS and CSS and invokes Presentation.

The complete local implementation consists of step data, the ordered STEPS array, ENTITIES, Scene and its content helpers, and presentation CSS. It introduces no duplicate navigation, scaling, or sta…
Presentation operates on supplied steps, title, initialMode, and brand, composing generic Stage, navigation, and chrome without demo-specific branches.

scene-kit.rationale: Steps carry stable identity, narration, and rendered diagram state.
evidence: answersBecomeSteps supplies id, era, title, caption, Scene, and payload. Stage selects the active step and passes its payload and stable id to ActiveScene; Header and Footer consume its narration.

scene-kit.rationale: The kit derives accessible step labels from order but does not render an on-screen step number.
evidence: Footer computes index + 1 only inside the progress button's aria-label; those buttons have no visible content. Header renders era/title or the deck title without a step number.

scene-kit.rationale: Typed payloads flow through the presentation boundary into the scene without casts.
evidence: Presentation<TPayload> passes its typed steps to Stage<TPayload>, whose ActiveScene passes step.payload directly to Scene.
The test 'carries a strongly typed payload to the Scene without casts' passes buildSteps(): Array<Step<GroupedPayload>> directly to Presentation and asserts the scene renders &#39…

scene-kit.rationale: Stable entity identifiers participate in implemented layout projection.
evidence: IconNode renders motion.div with layoutId, layout, and LAYOUT_TRANSITION; Box delegates to it.
Stage places scenes inside LayoutGroup and concurrent AnimatePresence. Scene reuses ENTITIES.you for the continuing Box across grouped updates.

scene-kit.rationale: Appear shares the layout duration correctly, but the supplied grouped transition introduces ordinary new entities without any delayed entry mechanism.
evidence: source audit: constants.ts ties ENTER_DELAY and LAYOUT_TRANSITION.duration to LAYOUT_T, and Appear.tsx consumes ENTER_DELAY.
source audit: 03-answers-become-steps.tsx and 04-the-deck-grows.tsx change cardCount from 1 to 3 within the same scene group.

source audit: scene.tsx introduces card2 and card3 as bare StepCard components. StepCard renders Box directly; IconNode.tsx has no initial opacity or delayed entry. These newcomers render immediately…

scene-kit.rationale: Grouped updates do not preserve conditionally removed child entities for exit animation.
evidence: Stage's AnimatePresence tracks the keyed canvas, whose key remains unchanged within a group; it does not track conditional children inside Scene.

Scene conditionally removes StepCard and Appear children without an inner AnimatePresence. Navigating from cardCount 3 back to cardCount 1 removes cards immediately; IconNode also defines no exit ani…

scene-kit.rationale: Matching group keys and scene components preserve the scene instance while payload changes.
evidence: Stage keys the canvas by step.groupKey ?? step.id and renders the same ActiveScene/Scene component path.
The test 'updates a grouped scene in place instead of remounting it' navigates between two growth-group steps, asserts canvas DOM identity, and verifies updated text 'a: 2'.

scene-kit.rationale: Continuing children remain mounted across grouped updates and do not restart entry state.
evidence: answersBecomeSteps and theDeckGrows share groupKey 'evolving-scene' and Scene. Stage therefore preserves their component tree.

Scene retains the unconditional you Box and first StepCard at the same child positions with stable layoutIds. Existing Appear wrappers also retain their component identity rather than receiving a new…

scene-kit.rationale: The grouped scene preserves authored positioning and layering without imposing a child arrangement.
evidence: SceneLayer renders children unchanged in an absolute layer and permits author style overrides. Frame forwards authored class/style while retaining layout projection.
Scene renders the reveal Frame alongside existing entities; .htmasp-reveal-frame uses absolute positioning and inset to overlay the composition.

scene-kit.rationale: Present mode renders the active marker and title while omitting reading controls.
evidence: Header's present branch renders activeStep.era and activeStep.title. Footer renders caption, progress, and previous/next controls only in browse mode; Presentation likewise gates Toc on browse mo…

scene-kit.rationale: Browse mode omits the required active step title.
evidence: Header's browse branch renders the presentation-level title prop instead of activeStep.title. Footer provides the caption, progress, and previous/next controls, and Presentation provides a wide-v…

scene-kit.rationale: Toggling mode changes only mode state.
evidence: usePresentationNav.toggleMode updates mode without updating stepIndex.
The hook test 'toggleMode preserves the current step' jumps to index 3, toggles mode, and asserts present mode with index still 3.

scene-kit.rationale: All required forward and backward keyboard mappings are implemented.
evidence: handleKeyDown maps ArrowRight, Space, and PageDown to next(), and ArrowLeft and PageUp to prev(), preventing default browser handling for accepted navigation events.

scene-kit.rationale: Swipe handling cannot reject predominantly vertical or multi-touch gestures.
evidence: handleTouchStart records only touches[0].clientX; handleTouchEnd compares only horizontal displacement against SWIPE_THRESHOLD. Neither records vertical coordinates nor validates touch count.
usePresentationNav.test.ts contains no focused assertions rejecting vertical or multi-touch gestures.

scene-kit.rationale: Progress and section controls invoke direct indexed navigation.
evidence: Footer progress buttons call onGoTo(index). Toc buttons call onSelect(entry.firstIndex). Presentation derives firstIndex from ordered steps and connects both callbacks to nav.goTo.

scene-kit.rationale: Navigation exposes semantic current state and stable styling hooks.
evidence: Footer compares each progress index with stepIndex and sets data-active plus aria-current='step'. Toc computes the active era range and sets data-active plus aria-current='true'.

scene-kit.rationale: Keyboard navigation returns before intercepting events targeting supported interactive controls.
evidence: isInteractiveTarget recognizes input, textarea, select, button, anchor, and contenteditable targets. handleKeyDown checks it before preventDefault or navigation.
The test 'does not advance when a keydown targets an interactive control' dispatches a bubbling ArrowRight event from a button and asserts the index remains zero.

scene-kit.rationale: Backward navigation clamps at zero without wrapping.
evidence: prev applies clampIndex(current - 1, stepCount), whose lower bound is zero.
The test 'clamps at the first step and does not wrap around' calls prev at the initial step and asserts index zero.

scene-kit.rationale: Forward navigation clamps at the final step without wrapping.
evidence: next applies clampIndex(current + 1, stepCount), whose upper bound is stepCount - 1.
The test 'clamps at the last step and does not wrap around' jumps to index 2 in a three-step deck, calls next, and asserts index 2.

scene-kit.rationale: The fit computation reserves chrome space and applies one scale factor to both canvas axes.
evidence: useFitScale takes the minimum of availableWidth/DESIGN_W and availableHeight/DESIGN_H, subtracting the active mode's chrome bands and optional Toc gutters.
Presentation places Stage between those same chrome bands. Stage consumes the factor through scale(scale) and adjusts its layout footprint with scaled margins.

scene-kit.rationale: The rendered authored canvas uses 880×380 dimensions.
evidence: constants.ts defines DESIGN_W = 880 and DESIGN_H = 380. Stage consumes both for the scaler and motion canvas width/height.

scene-kit.rationale: Primitives and chrome expose stable DOM hooks and accept author styling without imposing visual treatments.
evidence: IconNode, Arrow, Frame, Label, Emphasis, Appear, and SceneLayer render data-presentation-node hooks and forward className/style; Box and SymbolChip delegate to IconNode.
Presentation, Stage, Header, Footer, and Toc expose stable and-scene classes and data-presentation-* hooks.

scene-kit.rationale: The reusable components supply motion and layout geometry without fallback visual styling.
evidence: The inspected primitive implementations forward author styles; their built-in properties are motion, rotation, or layer geometry. Chrome and stage inline styles only position and size the layout.
Box's 'renders no fallback color, font, border, or shadow styling' test renders an unstyled Box and asserts empty class, color, backgroundColor, border, boxShadow, and fontFamily.

scene-kit.rationale: Styling frameworks are not required dependencies of the kit or bootstrap package.
evidence: Both package manifests declare React, React DOM, Motion, and Lucide runtime dependencies without a styling framework.
Talk imports presentation-owned plain CSS, whose selectors style the kit's hooks directly.

scene-kit.rationale: Authors can supply literal coordinates or arbitrary motion elements inside the fixed canvas.
evidence: IconNode and Frame forward style and className directly to motion elements with stable layoutIds, allowing absolute coordinates.
SceneLayer renders arbitrary children unchanged, and Stage mounts the supplied Scene within LayoutGroup without filtering or replacing authored elements.

scene-kit.rationale: The kit itself renders and positions the default repository attribution at bottom-right.
evidence: Footer renders 'made by and-scene' linking to https://github.com/Codagent-AI/and-scene with absolute right: 0 and bottom: 0. Its footer is itself anchored to the presentation's bottom edg…
The layout test 'anchors the footer to the bottom edge and the attribution to the bottom-right corner' renders Presentation and asserts those inline positioning properties.

scene-kit.rationale: The attribution exposes stable hooks for host-owned styling.
evidence: Footer's attribution anchor has className='and-scene-attribution' and data-presentation-attribution. The sample stylesheet directly targets the latter.

scene-kit.rationale: Header branding is empty by default and explicitly supplied by the host.
evidence: Presentation forwards its optional brand value to Header, whose brand slot renders only that value with no fallback.
Presentation tests assert an empty default brand slot and verify that brand={<span>Host Brand</span>} renders the supplied content.

presentation-skill.rationale: Complete prompts explicitly bypass redundant gathering questions.
evidence: SKILL.md §1 directs the agent to proceed straight to scaffolding/generation when the prompt supplies topic, style, and every step.
